name: Sakusaku Slide Any Block for Elementor
author: sampei1089

sections.description:
Compatible with Elementor 3.x and 4.x.
This plugin requires Elementor to be installed and activated.
This plugin includes the Swiper library (https://swiperjs.com/) licensed under the MIT License.

Sakusaku Slide Any Block for Elementor converts selected Elementor blocks into a Swiper slider.

This plugin is an independent product and not affiliated with or endorsed by Elementor.

More details, live examples, and usage instructions:
https://sampei1089.com/product/sakusaku-slide-any-block-for-elementor/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Elementor.
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.

short_description: Convert any selected Elementor blocks into a Swiper slider on the front end.
